source_title: 딜템 다 양보하고 힐템입고 만렙찍으면 이렇게됨
subtitle: 60렙에 24렙 손목 낀 착한 힐러의 최후

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
증뎀 템은 딜러님 드세요!
전 힐템만 먹을게요
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle medium shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch. On the left, Night Elf Priest (no halo, no wings, golden cross staff stowed on back) smiles warmly and gestures generously with both empty hands toward a glowing blue cloth caster chestpiece on the floor. On the right, Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) beams happily while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) claps excitedly beside her.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
만렙 축하! 근데 손목이
왜 아직 24렙 녹템임?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cobblestone floor touch and open white space on the upper right. On the left foreground, Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) leans in pointing in total shock while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) peers closely with wide confused eyes. On the right, Night Elf Priest (no halo, no wings, golden cross staff stowed on back) awkwardly lifts her sleeve showing a worn green cloth wrist wrap with a nervous sweat drop.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic action shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy field touch. On the left, sweaty Night Elf Priest (no halo, no wings) channels a tiny puny golden sparkle from her golden cross staff that barely tickles a yawning unbothered cute 2.5-head chibi SD level-60 grey wolf mob. On the right, Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle slung on back) leans back chuckling while her cute round chubby brown baby bear (green scarf) giggles behind its paws beside her.

Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with crisp dark-violet shock lines. Centered, Night Elf Priest (no halo, no wings) freezes with hollow shocked eyes, pale shadow across her forehead, and a huge cold sweat drop as her gentle healer patience finally snaps.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
착하게 양보한 죄로
만렙 필드도 못 돌다니…
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle dramatic shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone touch. On the left, Night Elf Priest (no halo, no wings, golden cross staff stowed on back) clutches a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold loot die with round dot pips only (no digits) while emitting a chilly dark-purple aura and eerie smile. On the right, Dwarf Hunter (rifle slung on back) and her cute round chubby brown baby bear (green scarf) back away sweating nervously.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
다음부턴 치증이든 증뎀이든
일단 입찰부터 누른다.
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view three-quarter wide comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch. On the left, Night Elf Priest (no halo, no wings, golden cross staff stowed on back) slams a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold loot die with round dot pips only (no digits) onto the ground with a fierce grin and sparkling purple determination aura. On the right, panicked Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) hugs her knees trembling while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) hides behind her in terror.
